# Danny On The Air (danny.vn)

> Personal site of Danny, a security engineer in Vietnam who builds security-as-code CLIs and MCP servers in Rust, Go, and Python, Go SDKs, and the aboutme.vn resume builder.

## Security as Code

These tools pull live security platform state into files for review, diff, and approved changes. Remote mutations are previews until `--yes`. Each ships a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.

- [splunkctl](https://splunkctl.danny.vn): Splunk Enterprise, Enterprise Security, and Splunk SOAR as code. Written in Python; install with `pip install splunkctl`. Independent project, unrelated to Splunk's official Go splunkctl. Source: https://github.com/dannyota/splunkctl
- [s1ctl](https://github.com/dannyota/s1ctl): SentinelOne Singularity as code
- [secopsctl](https://github.com/dannyota/secops): Google SecOps, including Chronicle SIEM and Siemplify SOAR, as code
- [elasticctl](https://github.com/dannyota/elasticctl): Elastic Security detection rules as code across self-managed, Elastic Cloud Hosted, and Serverless deployments, written in Rust. Its MCP server exposes read-only inspection tools.

## Building

- [aboutme](https://aboutme.vn): free, open-source resume builder for Vietnamese and English with public resume links and PDF export. Go, Nuxt, PostgreSQL. Source: https://github.com/dannyota/aboutme
- [trachuan](https://github.com/dannyota/trachuan): citable corpus of Vietnamese law for AI agents (over MCP) and people. Evidence only. In early development; no public service yet.
- Archived: [banhmi](https://github.com/dannyota/banhmi), [compliary](https://github.com/dannyota/compliary), [mise](https://github.com/dannyota/mise). Their public endpoints are offline.

## Go SDKs

- danny.vn/s1: SentinelOne Singularity
- danny.vn/secops: Google SecOps
- danny.vn/vngcloud: GreenNode (formerly VNG Cloud) SDK and AWS-style CLI
- danny.vn/fortigate: FortiGate firewall REST API
- danny.vn/fortimgr: FortiManager FlatUI API
- danny.vn/nessus: Tenable Nessus scanner (read-only)
- danny.vn/kaggle: Kaggle API

## Open Source

- [onnxruntime/go](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/29615): official Go bindings for the ONNX Runtime C API via CGO, merged into microsoft/onnxruntime
- [splunk-sdk-python](https://github.com/dannyota/splunk-sdk-python): Splunk SDK for Python
- [flowcvcli](https://github.com/dannyota/flowcvcli): FlowCV resume control from the command line or Python
- All repositories: https://github.com/dannyota
